pane.waitingNote: The thread exists on the daemon. Nothing has streamed yet; the first token will replace this outline.
pane.stillActive: {{message}} The run may still be active on its host.
pane.notFound: It may have been settled, or the daemon restarted. The run may still be active on its host.
pane.nothingLost: The run may still be active there; nothing on this device was lost.
pane.readingAsOf: The turn may still be running there. You’re reading the stream as of {{time}}.
pane.emptyFinished: The thread is finished on {{host}}. Reply below to start the next turn.
pane.emptyIdle: The thread is idle on {{host}}. Reply below to start the next turn.

turn.editHint: Edit this prompt and resend it
turn.retryable: The turn can be retried from the composer.
turn.failed: The turn failed. Nothing after this ran.
turn.interrupted: The turn was interrupted. Nothing after this ran.
turn.paused: Stream paused at {{time}} · will catch up on reconnect

stopped.token_limit: Stopped: the agent hit its token limit.
stopped.turn_limit: Stopped: the agent hit its turn-request limit.

limit.title: Usage limit hit.
limit.armedIn: Auto-resume is armed; it resumes in {{time}}.
limit.offAfter: Auto-resume is off. Resume manually after {{time}}.

rewind.notLoaded: The thread is not loaded yet.
rewind.unsupported: {{harness}} cannot drop turns from its own history.
rewind.delivery: A message may have reached the agent. Resend or discard it first.
rewind.queued: A message is waiting to run. Let it finish first.
rewind.running: Wait for the current turn to finish, or stop it first.

approval.label: Approval request

wants.command: {{harness}} on {{host}} wants to run a command
wants.file_change: {{harness}} on {{host}} wants to change a file
wants.permission: {{harness}} on {{host}} wants to use a permission
wants.plan: {{harness}} on {{host}} wants to review a plan
wants.question: {{harness}} on {{host}} wants to answer a question

approval.reconnect: Reconnect to approve or deny. Nothing runs until you do.

guest.sendHint: Send runs it as a turn with this thread’s current permissions.

attachments.notSent: The daemon did not send the file.
attachments.downloadHint: {{message}} Check the connection, then try again.
attachments.previewFailed: {{message}} Check the connection, or download the original.
attachments.loadFailed: The file could not be loaded.
attachments.stalled: The daemon stopped sending the file.

fork.gone: Forked from a thread that is no longer in your list

harnessSwitch.title: Switch harness
harnessSwitch.noOther: No other harness is installed on this host. Install one in Settings → Harnesses, then come back.
harnessSwitch.note: The thread keeps its history, workspace and every setting the new harness offers. It continues from a handoff of the conversation.
harnessSwitch.dropped: Dropped {{settings}}; the new harness has no such setting.

changes.loadFailed: The change list did not load.
changes.emptyBody: Files {{harness}} edits in this thread show up here, grouped by turn, with a diff against HEAD one click away.
changes.ideNote: Files open in the editor, compared with the agent’s starting point. Pick a turn above to narrow it.

confirm.fileBody: The file goes back to the state it had before this turn. This cannot be undone from here.
confirm.allBody_one: The file in this scope goes back to its pre-turn state. This cannot be undone from here.
confirm.allBody_other: All {{count, number}} files in this scope go back to their pre-turn state. This cannot be undone from here.

errors.noChangeSet: The daemon did not return a change set.
errors.binary: Binary files cannot be reverted from here.
errors.notDeleted: The daemon did not delete the file.
errors.notWritten: The daemon did not write the file.
errors.conflict: The file changed after the diff loaded. Reload and try again.

phone.empty: No changes in this thread yet.
phone.desktopOnly: Files and the IDE are on desktop.

subagents.emptyBody: When {{harness}} hands work to a subagent, it shows here with where it runs, its budget, and what it’s waiting on.

phone.needsApprovalTurn: Needs approval · turn {{turn, number}} of {{cap, number}}
phone.note: A subagent’s approval always comes to its parent thread, so it also shows above the composer.

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.startIn: Start a shell in <path>{{cwd}}</path>. It runs on {{host}} and keeps running when this panel closes.
terminal.reconnectHint: Reconnect and the terminal will open on its own.
terminal.closeHint: Close this tab and open a new terminal.
terminal.offlineHint: Reconnect in the status bar; this terminal opens when the daemon is back.
terminal.sized: Sized to this phone. Desktop viewers see the same {{cols}} columns.
terminal.failedHint: Check that the working directory exists and the daemon is still running.
